title: Cupulate caseiro
creator: well.chef
statusNote: This is a process video (fermenting, drying and roasting cupuaçu seeds) with no amounts.
steps: Remove the seeds from the cupuaçu and ferment them for about 6 days.
Dry them in the sun for 5–10 days.
Roast, shell and grind them with sugar into a smooth paste, as with chocolate.
